location_patterns.basis: canonical location_id from persons/firs rows; raw coordinates are never clustered

bridge_network_structure.basis: Phase 2 betweenness on the undirected person projection (overlay and self-loops excluded)

evidence_policy.nlp_derived: Phase 3 rule-extraction claims about FIR free text, each carrying its own extraction confidence
evidence_policy.separation: reported in separate collections and never merged
evidence_policy.nlp_scoring: NLP-derived evidence is attached and reported but does not raise any score in this build

self_reference_policy: Self-calls, self-transfers and self-FIR references are excluded from all Phase 4 detection and scoring. The records remain available as Phase 1/2 evidence.
overlay_policy: The SAME_RING ground-truth overlay is never an input to Phase 4 detection or scoring.
ranking_note: Investigation-priority ranking from the Phase 4 explainable 0-100 score. This is NOT the Phase 2 graph-based network importance ranking served by /api/v1/analytics/persons/top; the two rank different things and are not interchangeable.
disclaimer: Investigation-prioritization signal computed from observed synthetic records only. It is NOT a probability of guilt, NOT a probability of criminality, and NOT proof of wrongdoing.
